thread_text:
sre-bot: INCIDENT: Sev2 - routing errors causing 5xx for ded-prod in eu-west1. Pager triggered. ticket: INC-4521.
Ashley: Oncall here, seeing elevated 502/503 for /v1/generate. Thanks for the page. Jumping in.
Ashley: Initial triage - traffic surge to a single pool + failed healthchecks on a subset of dedicated nodes.
Mike: I can look at autoscaler logs and balancer config. Ashley, any quick mitigation you'd like?
Ashley: Can we temporarily route traffic to fallback pool in us-west while we fix eu-west? don’t want global failures.
Jordan: I can flip the routing policy to prefer us-west for new sessions. Will run a safe gradual shift.
Ashley: Do it. Add 10% -> 50% -> 100% over 2m steps. Notify when at 100%.
Jordan: Kicking now.
Sam (DevEx): Noted — customer impact message draft in #support-distro below, if you want me to post.
Ashley: Yes, please post "We are investigating increased errors for generation requests in eu-west. Minimal customer impact due to fallback routing; we'll provide updates."
Sam (DevEx): Posted.
Mike: Autoscaler logs show a flurry of failed pod pulls around 07:11:03 UTC and then healthcheck flaps. Looks like node-level oom kills on a subset (ded-nodepool-eu-3).
Ashley: Any recent deploys or model rollouts in that pool?
Mike: There was a canary bump of a quantized model yesterday evening targeting eu-west. Canary passed but may have memory edge-case at scale.
Irene: Product side: a few enterprise customers in eu-west reported higher error rates. Ticket INC-4521 linked to customer cases CUS-987, CUS-1012.
Ashley: Prioritize containment: 1) divert new traffic (Jordan) 2) cordon ded-nodepool-eu-3 3) revert canary to previous model variant 4) restart affected agents.
Jordan: Nodepool cordoned and draining. New sessions flowing to us-west.
Mike: Revert of model variant initiated: rolling back image tag:redwood/model-q1:202703 -> :202702.
Mike: Restarting inference agents on drained nodes now.
Ashley: Logging this sequence to INC-4521 and creating a follow-up postmortem thread after stabilization.
Sam (DevEx): Customer comms updated with ETA: "Investigating — mitigation in progress; full resolution ETA 1h."
Jordan: Traffic now stable, error rate down to baseline after shift.
Ashley: Good. Leave cordon in place until we confirm zero flaps for 30m.
sre-bot: NOTE: heartbeat-alert cleared for /v1/generate — observed 15m of healthy responses after reroute.
Mike: From heap profiles we saw memory usage spike ~20% above baseline under specific prompt patterns. Root cause hypothesis: quantization change exposed an allocation regression for long prompt sequences.
Irene: Product: will surface prompt samples to ML team for repro. Also compiling impacted customer logs.
Ashley: Next steps: schedule postmortem and assign action owners: - Action A: ML to reproduce memory regression & fix (owner: Mike) - Action B: Improve canary gating metrics for memory and tail latency (owner: Jordan) - Action C: Runbook update for routing fallback (owner: Ashley) - Action D: Customer post-incident summary (owner: Sam (DevEx))
Mike: Estimated dev cycle for ML fix: 2 weeks, will try for hotfix if repro straightforward.
Jordan: Canary gating: propose adding mem-95 and tail-latency-99 checks and a pressure test at 2x typical concurrency. Will draft PR.
Ashley: I'm scheduling the postmortem meeting. Proposed times: Wed 09:00 UTC or Thu 16:00 UTC. Please indicate availability.
Sam (DevEx): I'll take notes and draft the public post-incident summary after the pm.
Irene: Wed 09:00 works for Product.
Mike: Thu 16:00 better for ML devs but can do Wed 09 if needed.
Jordan: Wed 09:00 OK for infra.
Ashley: Let's lock Wed 09:00 UTC. Calendar invite: https://calendar.redwood.com/event/pm-INC-4521.
Ashley: Action owners, add target dates to the incident tracker (INC-4521) and ping me when items are added.
Mike: Added Action A to INC-4521 with owner + label "ml/regression" due 2027-04-10.
Jordan: Added Action B to INC-4521 and opened PR draft: https://git.redwood.com/r/redwood/infra/pull/2345.
Ashley: For runbook changes, please include minimal rollback steps and the exact routing commands. Paste example here for safety:
Jordan: ```
# shift traffic to fallback pool (10% -> 50% -> 100%)
redwood route adjust --from eu-west1 --to us-west1 --percent 10
sleep 120
redwood route adjust --from eu-west1 --to us-west1 --percent 50
sleep 120
redwood route adjust --from eu-west1 --to us-west1 --percent 100
```
Ashley: Also add verification checklist: check error-rate < 0.5% and tail-latency < 1500ms for 15m after shift.
Sam (DevEx): For the org brown-bag: propose "Preventing rollout regressions: canary gating and pressure tests" — aim for next Tuesday 15:00 UTC. I'll propose in #engineering-all.
Irene: +1 from Product — would like a short segment on customer communication templates.
Mike: I'll present the ML repro story and mitigations.
Ashley: I'll present runbook updates and oncall learnings. Jordan: I'll cover infra gating and autoscaler checks.
Sam (DevEx): Created draft invite: https://calendar.redwood.com/event/brownbag-rollout-guardrails. Will send after PM and once action owners confirm.
Ashley: Postmortem doc skeleton: INC-4521/postmortem with sections: timeline, impact, root cause, actions, follow-ups, owners, retrospective notes. Sam, please own summary for customers.
Sam (DevEx): Will draft customer-friendly summary and share for review by EOD.
Ashley: Closing incident channel for containment, keeping postmortem thread open. Thanks everyone for quick response. :thumbsup:
Mike: Good job team.
Irene: Thanks — useful drill.
Sam (DevEx): Will send brown-bag invite once PM is recorded.
sre-bot: Reminder: create postmortem within 72h to comply with incident policy (link: https://confluence.redwood.com/incidents/policy).
